top_signals.title: Zambian Budget Gets Copper Boost With El Niño Threatening Crops
top_signals.summary: Zambian Finance Minister Situmbeko Musokotwane unveils his 2027 budget plan on Friday with near-record copper prices providing a strong tailwind for Africa’s second-biggest producer of the metal.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.
